title: Targeting PTK2 by vaccarin alleviates osteoporosis through inhibiting ferroptosis via modulating P53 acetylation/succinylation.
authors: Wang, Yanna; Wang, Changyuan; Gong, Ying; Li, Qingchen; Liu, Mozhen; Sun, Huijun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究vaccarin通过PTK2调控P53乙酰化/琥珀酰化抑制铁死亡治疗骨质疏松，虽含分子对接但核心为疾病机制与药物筛选，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoporosis (OP) is a systemic skeletal disorder marked by reduced bone density and deterioration of trabecular microstructure. Recent studies have established ferroptosis as a major contributor to osteoporotic bone loss; however, the specific molecular mechanisms underlying this process remain incompletely understood. In this study, RNA sequencing revealed decreased expression of protein tyrosine kinase 2 (PTK2) in OP, while bioinformatics analyses identified a significant association between PTK2 and the ferroptosis-related gene P53. Mechanistically, lysine acetyltransferase 8 (MOF) acts as a key acetyltransferase for P53 acetylation. We found that PTK2 negatively regulates ferroptosis by competitively binding with MOF, thereby inhibiting both the acetylation and succinylation of P53 at the K120 site. This inhibition restores the transcriptional expression of fibronectin 1 (FN1). Using computer-aided molecular docking, we identified vaccarin-a bioactive small-molecule compound from the Selleck.cn natural product library-as a PTK2-targeting agent. Vaccarin not only suppressed erastin-induced ferroptosis but also enhanced the osteogenic differentiation of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs). Finally, we demonstrated that adenoviral overexpression of PTK2 (ADV-PTK2) or treatment with Vaccarin attenuated ovariectomy (OVX)-induced ferroptosis and osteoporosis in mice. These findings highlight PTK2 as a promising therapeutic target for OP and suggest that targeting PTK2-mediated ferroptosis inhibition may offer a novel therapeutic approach for osteoporosis management.
abstract_zh: 骨质疏松症（Osteoporosis, OP）是一种以骨密度降低和骨小梁微结构退化为特征的系统性骨骼疾病。近期研究已确定铁死亡（ferroptosis）是骨质疏松性骨丢失的重要促成因素；然而，其背后的具体分子机制仍未完全阐明。在本研究中，RNA测序揭示OP中蛋白酪氨酸激酶2（protein tyrosine kinase 2, PTK2）表达降低，而生物信息学分析确定了PTK2与铁死亡相关基因P53之间的显著关联。机制上，赖氨酸乙酰转移酶8（MOF）是P53乙酰化的关键乙酰转移酶。我们发现PTK2通过竞争性结合MOF负向调控铁死亡，从而抑制P53在K120位点的乙酰化和琥珀酰化。这种抑制恢复了纤连蛋白1（fibronectin 1, FN1）的转录表达。利用计算机辅助分子对接，我们从Selleck.cn天然产物库中鉴定出vaccarin——一种生物活性小分子化合物——作为靶向PTK2的药剂。Vaccarin不仅抑制了erastin诱导的铁死亡，还增强了骨髓间充质干细胞（bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells, BMSCs）的成骨分化。最后，我们证明腺病毒过表达PTK2（ADV-PTK2）或Vaccarin处理可减轻小鼠卵巢切除术（ovariectomy, OVX）诱导的铁死亡和骨质疏松。这些发现突显了PTK2作为OP的有前景治疗靶点，并提示靶向PTK2介导的铁死亡抑制可能为骨质疏松管理提供一种新型治疗策略。
